practices.prior_belief: Store embeddings as numeric arrays (number[]) in documents when using the provider's native vector indexes (rather than as BSON binary blobs) because native vector indexes generally require numeric arrays and may not index binary-encoded vectors.

practices.practice: L2-normalize embeddings at ingest time when using cosine similarity (COS) and store the embedding model name and dimension metadata alongside the vector so you can detect model drift and re-embed when needed.
practices.prior_belief: Normalize embeddings to unit length at insert time if you plan to use cosine similarity, so you can use dot product on normalized vectors as the similarity measure.

practices.practice: Compute embeddings at write/ingest time and store them with the document (do not recompute embeddings on every query) so queries avoid the cost and latency of repeated embedding calls.

practices.practice: Create B-tree (regular) indexes on metadata fields used for filtering (e.g., modality, body_part), and prefer well-shaped compound indexes (Equality → Sort → Range / ESR) rather than many single-field indexes.

practices.practice: Limit result sizes and return a small top-K (e.g., top 10); use limit/pagination or cursor-based paging for larger result sets and avoid unbounded sorts.
